skills.name: amplify-backend-standards
skills.description: Non-negotiable rules under amplify/: function folder layout (services, repositories, builders, utils), shared code, interface DI, zod input, cycles, secrets. Use when writing or reviewing any file under amplify/.

skills.name: amplify-data-model
skills.description: Changes the Amplify Gen 2 schema in amplify/data/resource.ts: models, relationships, secondary indexes, auth rules, custom operations. Use when asked to "add a model", "add a field", "add an index", "change auth rules".

skills.name: amplify-deploy
skills.description: Deploys and debugs an Amplify Gen 2 backend: ampx sandbox, function logs, secrets, failed CloudFormation and circular-dependency errors. Use when asked to "deploy", "run the sandbox", "why did the deploy fail".

skills.name: amplify-lambda
skills.description: Adds or changes an Amplify Gen 2 Lambda or Cognito trigger: scaffold, handler, services, repositories, tests, registration. Use for "add a lambda", "post-confirmation trigger", "API endpoint", "SQS consumer".

skills.name: appsync-js-resolver
skills.description: Writes or reviews AppSync APPSYNC_JS resolvers under amplify/data: cross-table names, ctx.identity, ctx.stash pipelines, a.handler.custom. Use when editing a resolver .js file or a resolver returns AccessDenied or null.
